text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I'm glad I came to see it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Her unwavering stride always serves to 
remind me—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of figure I ought to strive 
to become...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"This is no time to lament a near-miss! 
Even if brought to one's knees, bruised 
and battered, one must rise—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Ooooh~~!! That was an awesome race~! Kris 
S was incredible as always, but this time, 
it's definitely gotta be—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City, incredible...!! She's 
gotten even stronger since last year!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Now that was a front-running run full of 
"romance"~!! Tap Dance City is definitely 
going to break out this autumn! I might 
just have to cheer for her...!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Is everyone looking at Tap-san...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...I produced "results." However—it was a 
race with many points to reflect upon.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (The greatest example of that being――)
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance Cityyy!! Keep showing us even 
more thrilling runs from now on!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Do your best!!! You were super cool, 
too!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!! Next time, I'll show you an 
even more passionate me!!!
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...There's no mistake. That is—pure 
frenzy.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Geez, and here I was planning to have the 
entire venue's eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You, and all the other Umamusume, are 
still plenty strong. It's frustrating, but 
it seems my passion today just wasn't 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...It's not just my imagination. Tap's 
passion, her presence— they've grown so 
much compared to before the race...!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even I can tell, Kris S. Right 
now, I'm getting hotter and hotter by the 
second.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll be so much stronger. So 
much hotter. Enough to drive everything 
completely wild...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My heart is fluttering like a kid's...! It 
feels as if a glistening golden ocean is 
right before my eyes!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――You're planning to run the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) again next, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, but that's not what I'm aiming 
for. Right now, my compass is pointing 
toward the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and defend your title. And make 
sure you come to the Japan Cup, without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll blow past you, the strongest, along 
with all the heavyweights in the world. 
And with that—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna smash the racing world's common 
sense to pieces!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (This is... this heat is——)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Something I don't have— something only 
they possess—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(It is something that changes... the 
people... the world... the memories... 
everything—)

"Showing 'results' with her unchangingly 
powerful running, Symboli Kris S returned. 
However—"

It was just an intuition. At first glance 
she seemed the same as always, but sensing 
something very subtle and off about her, I 
couldn't help but ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――No problem. ...I am fine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Next up... is the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I will learn from today's mistakes... and 
definitely... achieve back-to-back 
victories."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So――……I'm counting on you.

"Maybe she can't put it into words right 
now... She's probably fatigued after the 
race too. I decide against pressing any 
further here."

However, keeping that sense of unease in 
mind, I firmly resolved within myself to 
watch her closely—
The day after the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“――Man, Tap Dance City was seriously 
awesome! The way she pushed relentlessly 
to the front was so cool!”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Isn't it insane that she can just 
casually talk about building a castle?! 
The way she just blazes her own trail is 
so, soooo cool...!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—If Tanino Gimlet had been there too, 
wouldn't it have been even more exciting? 
After all, it's still fresh in everyone's 
memory."

"...After the 'Takarazuka Kinen', the 
public's interest in Tap Dance City was 
visibly surging."

Between her skill improving recently and 
the popularity of her free-spirited 
running and personality, it seems a kind 
of frenzy is brewing around her—
choice_data_list:
(Just when people were finally starting to 
see her in a new light, too—)

(Just when people were finally starting to 
see her in a new light—)

text_block_list.text:
Just as the public perception of Symboli 
Kris S was finally beginning to shift 
after his string of successes, this fervor 
swept in.

I secretly prayed that it wouldn't have 
any negative impact on Symboli Kris S...
And yet, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"—If Tanino Gimlet had been there too, 
wouldn't it have been even more exciting? 
After all, it's still fresh in everyone's 
memory—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Forget Tap... I have yet to surpass the 
fervor left behind by Gimlet, who has 
already stepped away from racing—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(That night, right here, I swore I would 
see it through, and yet—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(If I let something like this stop me... 
then I—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A "revolution," you say...—

"With her second Tenno Sho (Autumn) lying 
ahead— Summer was about to arrive."
